end.summary:
• Discussed health as physical, mental and social well-being, not only being free from disease.
• Used examples involving sleep, food, exercise, loneliness and friendships.
• Planned small routine changes such as walking with a friend, reducing screen time and improving sleep.
• Siya did not complete the final teach-back independently.
end.parentNote: Siya practised looking at health in three parts: body, mind and relationships, rather than only asking whether someone visited a doctor. They initially mixed up “not being ill” with being fully healthy, then later identified that poor sleep, food choices and loneliness can affect overall health. At home, ask Siya to name one small daily change and explain its expected effect on the body, mind or relationships.
